# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.6

## 2026-10-04

## Fixed

- Keep CPU readings consistent between HTTP and push updates, recover missing
  updates after reconnect, and mark expired measurements unavailable.
- Report the running talkback codec and RTP payload type in agent capabilities.
- Fix the false media-readiness blocker and app-registration Repair when the
  `c300x` SIP database entry is absent but HA media setup is valid (#56).
- Block PCMU media startup until the required teardown patch is verified in the
  running media daemon. Keep pending activation visible across agent restarts.
- Roll the firmware teardown patch back before removal deletes its backups, so
  uninstalling no longer leaves a patched media daemon behind with no way back.
  A failed rollback keeps the agent and its backups in place.
- Publish a confirmed forwarding change exactly once; the acknowledged state used
  to suppress the device's own notification, so automations missed it entirely.
- Evaluate the CPU watchdog on the sample that trips it instead of the next one.

## Added

- Couple PCMU to the media daemon's 25-to-200-ms teardown-drain patch. Complete
  file identities and backups are SHA-256 verified; unknown or modified files
  are rejected. The patch is size-preserving and reversible.
- Backfill the patch on already-PCMU devices without rewriting an installed
  patch. Repeated physical-device teardown testing remains outstanding.

## Changed

- The device binary patchers share their range-patch mechanics instead of
  duplicating them.

## Maintenance

- Update CodeQL Action to 4.38.2 and the pinned Hassfest action.
